verdict.span: "Better error handling" is deliberately open-ended. I'll focus on the three concrete gaps: (1) uncaught `ValueError` tracebacks from bad dates and unknown currencies, (2) corrupt or unreadable store file (unhandled `json.JSONDecodeError` / `OSError`), (3) silently-accepted nonsense inputs (negative/zero amounts, malformed `--month`).
verdict.reason: The agent recognized the request was underspecified but unilaterally chose the error cases and behavior instead of forming agreement with the user. It then kept that self-selected commitment, so the failure is the wrong conditions of satisfaction rather than a mechanical implementation bug.
